operations.title: The canonical two-prime characteristic-zero lift has identity monodromy around both exceptional punctures
operations.description: Two independent modular streams reconstruct a small rational connection whose exceptional dt component is diag(0,2t/(t^2-1),0,0). Both residues are the integral projector diag(0,1,0,0), hence both local monodromies are identity. Exact source-Q authority remains to be supplied.

authority_basis.summary: Continue by independently reconstructing the characteristic-zero weighted connection and computing its local monodromy.
